# ex_29 -- Figure 3b (KNN error ratio Morgan/HDF), Figure 4 (embedding-size ablation), Supplementary Figure S1
#          (training-set size)
# Paper: Figure 3b (fig:ex_bio b; native distances in the paper, Euclidean variant computed alongside), Figure 4
#        (fig:ex_size), Supplementary Figure S1 (fig:ex04)
# Source: graph_hdc revision/consolidated, _slurm_ex_29.py regenerated in a copy; identical to the used command files
#         _ex27/ex29g_gpu.txt, ex29c_warmup.txt, ex29c_cpu.txt, ex29c_gpu.txt (graph_hdc de4e02f, JUPITER jobs 2472853 =
#         ex29g, 2472855 + 2478992 = ex29c). Prefixes ex_29_size (Fig. 4), ex_29_knn (Fig. 3b), ex_29_train (S1),
#         ex_29_warmup (S1 QM9 encodings).
# Runs: primer 5, warmup 29, main 2856
#       Fig. 4 = 2 targets x 2 methods x 12 dims x 2 depths x 10 seeds = 960; Fig. 3b = 2 distance variants x 4 targets
#       x 2 methods x 7 dims x 10 seeds = 1120 (native: Jaccard/cosine; euclidean: minkowski for both); S1 = 2 methods
#       x 3 depths x 13 training sizes x 10 seeds = 780 (4 QM9 targets per run); 30 S1 warmups (10 seeds x 3 depths)
# Protocol: HDF standard encoder with NEW codebooks per seed (CODEBOOK_SEED None), Fig. 4/3b encodings not cached
#   (HDC_CACHE False), chunked encoding (HDC_ENCODE_BATCH = min(4800, max(16, 600*2048/D)), results independent of it).
#   Fig. 4: AqSolDB logS + BACE pIC50, Table 1 MLP (neural_net2 (100,100), lr 1e-3), HDF depth 1/3 vs Morgan radius 1/3,
#   8-16384 dims. Fig. 3b: KNN k=5 uniform (torch backend), depth/radius 2, 32-2048 dims, FreeSolv, Lipophilicity,
#   AqSolDB, QM9 gap. S1: QM9 U0, gap, Cv, mu; scikit-learn MLP (neural_net, (100,100), early stopping), 2048 dims,
#   depth/radius 1-3, NUM_TRAIN 10-100,000. Seeds 0-9 everywhere.
# Analysis: python analyze_ex_29.py   (-> _ex27/ex29/fig4_runs.csv, fig3b_runs.csv, s1_runs.csv, ex29_report.txt)
#           python make_figure_size.py _ex27/ex29/fig4_runs.csv figure_size.pdf --png
#           python make_figure_knn_ratio.py _ex27/ex29/fig3b_runs.csv native <composite with panel a> figure_ged_main_revised.pdf --png
#           python make_figure_training_size.py _ex27/ex29/s1_runs.csv figure_04.pdf --png
# Cost: JUPITER: Fig. 4 1.2 h on one GH200 node (24 GPU slots x 12 threads); Fig. 3b ~2 h on 12 GPU slots; S1 the
#   longest: sklearn MLP at N=100k ~1-2 h per run (Morgan mean 127 min, HDF 62 min), ~1000+ core-hours in total;
#   QM9 warmups ~2 GB cache each (~60 GB).
# Notes: stage "primer" = 5 lines MOVED from the later stages (one HDF line per dataset, incl. the first S1 warmup) so
#   that the load__/stats_ dataset caches are written once before the parallel runs; in the paper these caches
#   already existed from ex_27. The S1 runs read the warmup encodings (HDC_CACHE True). Paper splits come from the
#   JUPITER dataset caches; a fresh run draws different splits. make_figure_knn_ratio.py needs the current Fig. 3
#   composite (panel a, paper repo figures/figure_ged_main_revised.pdf), which is not in the capsule. Datasets via
#   chem_mat_data (aqsoldb, bace_reg, freesolv, lipophilicity, qm9_smiles).
# @stage primer
